description: Local capability declarations for the portable Charter Kit workflow. This file is diagnostic metadata only; it never installs or executes a dependency.

providers.role: project-local helper, utility, mapper, and module discovery
providers.impact: Project-local reuse search guidance is unavailable.
providers.fallback: Use the portable local reuse check; install only as a separate user action.

providers.role: framework, SDK, dependency, and shared-component discovery
providers.impact: Framework and ecosystem reuse guidance is unavailable.
providers.fallback: Inspect declared frameworks, SDKs, and dependencies manually; install only as a separate user action.

providers.role: Build-vs-Reuse cost, risk, and maintenance trade-off
providers.impact: A dedicated Build-vs-Reuse trade-off checklist is unavailable.
providers.fallback: Use the portable candidate and maintenance checklist; install only as a separate user action.

providers.role: discovery of existing Agent Skills only
providers.impact: Installed or public Agent Skill discovery guidance is unavailable.
providers.fallback: Record a bounded Skill inventory manually; discovery never installs a Skill.

providers.role: authorized follow-up to turn a selected repository into a Skill
providers.fallback: Do not convert a repository; create a separately authorized follow-up task first.

capabilities.impact: The shared charter and evidence documents cannot be read reliably.
capabilities.fallback: Read the supplied Markdown manually and record the limitation.

capabilities.impact: The project working set and evidence cannot be persisted.
capabilities.fallback: Ask the user to provide a writable project directory before continuing.

capabilities.impact: The bundled initializer, dependency diagnostics, and any generated convenience artifact cannot run automatically; the governance core is Markdown and stays usable without them.
capabilities.fallback: Create the working set manually from the templates, add the .jspace/ entry to .gitignore by hand because the initializer is what normally writes it, and record a host-native check.

capabilities.impact: Branch, commit, and post-integration provenance cannot be checked automatically.
capabilities.fallback: Record the host or manual version identifier in the charter.

capabilities.impact: Native planning, TDD, debugging, review, and verification helpers are unavailable.
capabilities.fallback: Use the portable Charter Kit checklists.

capabilities.impact: Native long-task ledger, seam refresh, and resume support are unavailable.
capabilities.fallback: Use .charter/handoff.md and the task ledger sections.

capabilities.impact: Interactive provider-backed questioning is unavailable during intent clarification.
capabilities.fallback: Use the bundled design-interview checklist and record FALLBACK.

capabilities.impact: The from-zero intent interview has no bundled portable implementation.
capabilities.fallback: Ask the same questions manually and record the limitation.

capabilities.impact: A fresh reviewer or independent process cannot be confirmed by a local file probe.
capabilities.fallback: When independent review is not triggered, record a bounded omission reason. When triggered but unavailable, record BLOCKED_TOOLING or obtain an explicit user waiver.
capabilities.action: if triggered, remain BLOCKED_TOOLING until a fresh reviewer is available or an explicit user waiver with limitation and expiry is recorded
